einzeiler: Costume designer Marissa Schwartz on styling the Gen Z hit series Sterling Point
kurzfassung: Costume designer Marissa Schwartz discusses her work on the hit series Sterling Point. She shares how she crafted distinct wardrobes for the show's Gen Z characters, balancing high-end fashion with authentic lake-life style. Schwartz also reveals behind-the-scenes details about collaborations with Chanel and vintage sourcing.

clips.text: The speaker explains how she secured a position despite not belonging to the required union at the time.

clips.text: Connor's clothing budget was the highest on the series even though his overall item count was remarkably small.

clips.text: An expensive designer coat was intentionally paired with an inexpensive basic tank top for the main character's travel outfit.

clips.hook: A massive wardrobe built entirely on a budget
clips.text: One character accumulated the largest collection of clothing on the show through inexpensive items and vintage finds.

clips.text: When existing options failed to meet technical requirements, the costume team manufactured a specific sauna bathing suit by hand.

beschreibung:
Marissa Schwartz is the costume designer behind the hit new Amazon Prime Video series Sterling Point. The show has gained acclaim for its fresh perspective on the YA genre and its commitment to representing its Gen Z characters authentically in the dialogue, the acting, and, of course, the outfits. In this episode, Schwartz shares how she approached dressing each of the characters and which brands she leaned on—from Chanel to Bode to Still Here—to help tell the story.
